# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 7 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 7 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_007_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 7

**7:1** When the child was two years old, Joachim said to Anna: "Let us take her up to the temple of the Lord, to fulfill the vow we made — lest the Lord send some misfortune upon us and our offering become unacceptable to him."

**7:2** Anna replied: "Let us wait until she is three, so that the child will not be looking for her father and mother." Joachim agreed: "Then we will wait."

**7:3** When the child had reached her third year, Joachim said: "Let us invite the undefiled daughters of the Hebrews. Have each one carry a burning lamp, so that the child will not look back and her heart be drawn away from the temple of the Lord."

**7:4** This was done, and they made their way up to the temple. The priest received Mary, kissed her, and blessed her, saying: "The Lord God has exalted your name in all generations. Through you the Lord will reveal his redemption to the children of Israel in the last days."

**7:5** He set her on the third step of the altar. The Lord God poured grace upon her, and she danced for joy, and all the house of Israel loved her.
